records.completion_scope: All22selected parts, actual chosen opening, intermediate joins, lake inlets/outlets, lower channel and actual terminal at ordinary regional/corridor scale. No exact-bank, current-flow, operating-state or endpoint-precision condition is imposed.

scope_limits: No representative river name was found in the bounded source/name pass. A completed naming-scope hold does not prove the river has no local or otherwise documented name.

research_order.progress_rule: Follow the actual continental order: Americas, Asia, Africa, Europe, then other, with all rivers before lakes.
